public_cost_contract.warrant: Every one of the eight fixed rows belongs to the declared six-mode set; convex source enlargement, no population inference or mode law

hull.domain: Cohort sums, not means. Exact hull of all compatible fixed-row configurations; no stochastic independence.
hull.construction: Sum over groups count_g * conv(public_modes allowed to group g)
hull.redundancy: Duplicate generators removed; no claim every retained point is extreme
